question: Why did the error rate go up on 07 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of catalog v2.23 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: The deployment of catalog v2.23 introduced a new version of the service.
The new version (v2.23) had a NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize.
This NullPointerException led to an increase in error rate.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of catalog v1.24 did not cause the error rate to spike.
why_chain: The deployment of catalog v1.24 was a routine release.
It did not introduce any new issues.
The error rate did not change significantly after this deployment.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No configuration change was recorded around the time of the error rate increase.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region us-east rose from 0.41% to 3.96% (+857%), with a change point at 2026-03-07T08:20:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.09).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (726 per 5 min before, 891 per 5 min after, +23%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (122 ms before, 121 ms after, -1%).
Deployed catalog v2.23 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R011)
High error rate on catalog in us-east (catalog, us-east; 10 min after the change; record R012)
Deployed catalog v1.24 to us-east (routine release) (catalog, us-east; 198 min before the change; record R010)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.23) (catalog, us-east; 14 min after the change; record R013)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.23) (catalog, us-east; 30 min after the change; record R014)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Fix the NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize in the v2.23 version of the service.
Implement a monitoring system to detect and alert on NullPointerExceptions in the RequestHandler.serialize method.
Review and stabilize the deployment process to ensure that only stable versions are released to production.
